name: IndiaTVDNA Search Optimization Toolkit
author: indiatvdna

sections.description:
IndiaTVDNA Search Optimization Toolkit brings practical WordPress SEO controls into one organized workspace. It helps site owners review page metadata, XML sitemaps, structured data, redirects and common technical SEO settings without requiring a paid license.

Core SEO and search appearance

  • SEO dashboard, site-health overview and links to common tools.
  • Editable titles, meta descriptions, canonical URLs and robots settings.
  • Open Graph and social metadata controls.
  • Basic structured data, breadcrumbs and webmaster verification fields.

Site discovery and maintenance

  • XML sitemaps for supported public post types and taxonomies.
  • Optional IndexNow notification integration, disabled by default.
  • Same-site redirect management and bounded 404 monitoring.
  • Basic technical and content SEO checks.
  • Image ALT/title assistance.

WooCommerce and migration

  • WooCommerce product metadata, supported identifiers and basic Product schema, when WooCommerce is active.
  • Yoast and Rank Math metadata migration helpers. Review migrated metadata before disabling another SEO plugin.
  • Settings import/export that excludes secret-like configuration fields.

Easy setup and transparent Free/Pro labels

Easy Auto Setup offers site-aware recommended settings for administrator review. Optional external services require separate configuration and permission. Free settings work without a payment, trial timer, quota or license key.

The dashboard groups tools into ten categories. Additional commercial tools are shown only as clearly labeled, read-only “PRO ONLY” previews; they are not part of this WordPress.org package. The separate commercial edition is available at https://indiatvdna.com/. Commercial-only code and AI-provider integration code are not included in this directory release.

Notes: SEO configuration does not guarantee rankings, indexing or performance scores. Confirm settings on your own site and check for overlapping SEO plugins before activating duplicate metadata features.

External services

IndexNow

IndexNow is optional and is OFF by default. If an administrator enables IndexNow, the plugin sends the site’s host name, IndexNow key/key location, and changed public URLs to the IndexNow endpoint so participating search engines can be notified about URL changes.

Service: https://www.indexnow.org/
API endpoint used: https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow
Documentation: https://www.indexnow.org/documentation
Terms and privacy information: https://www.indexnow.org/terms

The plugin does not add advertising tracking. Optional local 404 monitoring and SEO diagnostics store their own technical records in the WordPress database. Review the corresponding settings before enabling optional modules.

Source code and build information

All source code required by this release is included in human-readable form inside the plugin ZIP. No obfuscated source code is used.

  • PHP source is included in includes/ and indiatvdna-search-optimization-toolkit.php.
  • Maintained JavaScript and CSS are included under assets/.
  • Readable reviewer/source copies of assets that were previously compacted are included under assets/src/, including the readable admin stylesheet.
  • The local feature catalog is included as assets/pro-feature-catalog.json.
  • No npm, webpack, minifier, obfuscator, transpiler, bundler, or other build tool is required to regenerate this release.

The files under assets/src/ are provided to make source review straightforward; no shipped asset depends on unavailable source code or proprietary build tooling.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or install it from WordPress.org.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Search Toolkit > Dashboard.
  4. Review Easy Auto Setup and SEO Settings before enabling optional integrations.
  5. If another SEO plugin is active, migrate and verify your metadata before disabling the old plugin.
sections.faq:
Is this a trial?

No. The functionality included in this WordPress.org ZIP is usable without a payment, license key, time limit or usage quota.

Is paid code hidden inside this plugin?

No. Commercial-only implementation code is not included in this package. A separate commercial edition may provide additional functionality.

Does this WordPress.org package use an AI provider?

No. This WordPress.org package does not include an AI-provider integration and does not send content to an AI service.

Does IndexNow run automatically after installation?

No. IndexNow is OFF by default and must be enabled by an administrator.

Will uninstalling erase SEO data?

Not by default. Data is preserved unless the administrator explicitly enables the clean-uninstall option first.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First WordPress.org release.
  • WordPress.org pre-review hardening: clean activation filesystem helpers, authentication-cookie exclusions for redirect conditions, WordPress-enqueued admin assets, safe JSON-LD encoding and readable asset source.
  • Renamed the directory edition to IndiaTVDNA Search Optimization Toolkit for a clearer, distinctive WordPress.org identity.
  • Free features are fully usable without a license, trial timer or quota.
  • Commercial/MAX/Agency/AI-provider implementation code is excluded from this package.
  • Added a read-only local catalog of the original 106 tool entries, grouped across 10 categories.
  • Pro previews link to the separate commercial edition on the plugin settings pages only.
  • Optional IndexNow network access is disabled by default.
